remarks: A fresh take on contemporary living in the Via Bluffs, where thoughtful architecture meets the ease of coastal living. Just a few blocks from Palisades Village, 687 N Hampden Place is offered as a pre-construction residence by Rolen Construction, with plans submitted to the City and currently awaiting approval. The proposed two-story home is designed with three bedrooms and three bathrooms, bringing together comfortable living spaces and a practical, well-considered layout. A spacious kitchen with a generous island and pantry opens to the main living area, creating a natural place to gather, entertain or simply enjoy everyday life.
